purpose: Known-answer vector for the bytes an authority key signs. This is the reference for a signer implemented outside this crate, in any language: build the same eight fields, produce the same XDR, and an ed25519 signature over it will verify inside the contract. The test attestation_xdr_matches_the_committed_vector regenerates every value below from the SDK and fails if any of them drifts.
encoding: The attestation is a soroban #[contracttype] struct, so its XDR is an ScVal of type ScMap with one entry per field, keyed by ScSymbol, and the entries are ordered by field name rather than by declaration order: amount, asset, category, expiry_ledger, network_id, pool, recipient, sequence. There is no domain separator and no length prefix around the struct. The bytes below are the whole preimage.
